title: SEC Insider Trading Scraper - Form 4 Insider Trades & Buys
description: Scrape SEC EDGAR Form 3/4/5 stock insider trades: insider buying and selling — from the official filings: one flat row per transaction with insider name, role, decoded code, shares, price, signed USD value and shares held after.
